proof_attempt_summary: D0 proved a total original-record estimator, explicit global risk bracket, exact arbitrary-sequence consistency, and sharp dense/logarithmic-quota regimes, after two solver rounds and independent maximality reviews. The promised absolute-constant all-tuple sharp law remains unresolved when capacity shrinks with H/D tending to zero: at H=sqrt(D), lambda=D^2, the attainable upper is D^-2 and available converses are D^-3. No Lean formalization was launched; the mathematics is honest partial work, but replacing the required frontier by an open question failed the accepted kernel. Re-raise only with an approved narrower contract or genuinely new matching-rate mathematics.
tldr: With known equal registry strata and the supplied symmetric binary randomized experiment, the oracle additional causal benefit per treatment slot is \(B_K\). We prove the evaluated all-tuple bracket \(c\max\{\rho_{\mathrm{lo}},1/n\}\leq R\leq C\rho_{\mathrm{up}}\), with a total deterministic original-record estimator whose worst-case risk is bounded by \(C\rho_{\mathrm{up}}\). The endpoints include occupancy, quota logarithms, and saturation, and give exact necessary-and-sufficient consistency for every tuple sequence. A diluted moment-prior converse closes both occupancy branches whenever \(K/d\) is bounded below by a fixed positive constant, with constants depending on that bound. The scarce match extends to \(H\geq D/4\); more generally it holds when \(H/D\) is bounded below. Sharp MSE order remains unresolved for intermediate shrinking-capacity sequences.
gap: Generic finite-affine recovery covers the target but retains a form-count sample multiplier; additive-kernel duality covers a fixed hinge but not its optimized threshold. Fixed-trial mixing-law theorems and global budget-curve results do not evaluate the original-record scarce-capacity precision law.
fill: The central open question demands an explicit all-tuple minimax scale and finite attainment. Moving-hinge polynomial lifting and lawful fixed-mass moment priors provide concrete construction handles, with empirical-target concentration and exact-sample transfer kept as obligations.
